hook.en: A straight line, a V, a staircase and three dots: each is the graph of a function you must know by sight.
hook.kn: ಸರಳ ರೇಖೆ, V ಆಕಾರ, ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲು ಮತ್ತು ಮೂರು ಬಿಂದುಗಳು: ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ನೀವು ನೋಡಿದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಗುರುತಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಫಲನಗಳ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು.

objectives.en: Recognise identity, constant, polynomial and rational functions
Use modulus, signum and greatest integer functions

narration.en: A straight line, a V, a staircase and three dots: each is the graph of a function you must know by sight.
narration.kn: ಸರಳ ರೇಖೆ, V ಆಕಾರ, ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲು ಮತ್ತು ಮೂರು ಬಿಂದುಗಳು: ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ನೀವು ನೋಡಿದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಗುರುತಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಫಲನಗಳ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು.

title.en: Identity, constant, polynomial and rational functions

body.en: Identity: $f(x) = x$, a line through the origin at 45°. Constant: $f(x) = c$, a horizontal line, range $\{c\}$. Polynomial: $f(x) = a_0 + a_1x + \dots + a_nx^n$ with $n$ a whole number. Rational: $f(x)/g(x)$ with $f, g$ polynomials and $g(x) \ne 0$.
body.kn: ಸರ್ವಸಮ ಫಲನ f(x) = x ಮೂಲಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಮೂಲಕ 45° ರೇಖೆ. ಸ್ಥಿರ ಫಲನ ಸಮತಲ ರೇಖೆ. ಬಹುಪದ ಫಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ ಘಾತಗಳು; ಭಾಗಲಬ್ಧ ಫಲನ ಎರಡು ಬಹುಪದಗಳ ಭಾಗಲಬ್ಧ.

narration.en: The identity function is the 45 degree line through the origin. A constant function is a horizontal line. Polynomial functions have whole-number powers, and a rational function is one polynomial divided by another.
narration.kn: ಸರ್ವಸಮ ಫಲನ f(x) = x ಮೂಲಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಮೂಲಕ 45° ರೇಖೆ. ಸ್ಥಿರ ಫಲನ ಸಮತಲ ರೇಖೆ. ಬಹುಪದ ಫಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ ಘಾತಗಳು; ಭಾಗಲಬ್ಧ ಫಲನ ಎರಡು ಬಹುಪದಗಳ ಭಾಗಲಬ್ಧ.

narration.en: Identity: f(x) = x is a straight line through the origin at 45 degrees.

say.en: Identity: f(x) = x is a straight line through the origin at 45 degrees.
Modulus: |x| is a V shape; its range is all non-negative reals.
Signum: 1 for positive x, minus 1 for negative x, and 0 at 0.
Greatest integer: [x] jumps up by 1 at every integer, a staircase.

body.en: Modulus: $|x| = x$ for $x \ge 0$ and $-x$ for $x < 0$; a V-shaped graph, range $[0, \infty)$. Signum: $1$ for $x > 0$, $0$ for $x = 0$, $-1$ for $x < 0$; range $\{-1, 0, 1\}$. Greatest integer $[x]$: the greatest integer $\le x$; a step graph, range $Z$.
body.kn: ಮಾಪಾಂಕ ಫಲನದ ನಕ್ಷೆ V ಆಕಾರ, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ [0, ∞). ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಫಲನ −1, 0, 1 ಮಾತ್ರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಹತ್ತಮ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ ಫಲನ [x] ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲು ನಕ್ಷೆ, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ Z.

narration.en: Modulus makes every number non-negative and has a V-shaped graph. Signum gives only one, zero or minus one. The greatest integer function rounds down to an integer and its graph is a staircase.
narration.kn: ಮಾಪಾಂಕ ಫಲನದ ನಕ್ಷೆ V ಆಕಾರ, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ [0, ∞). ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಫಲನ −1, 0, 1 ಮಾತ್ರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಹತ್ತಮ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ ಫಲನ [x] ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲು ನಕ್ಷೆ, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ Z.

caption.en: Start with y = x, the identity function, then change the slope and intercept.

tryThis.en: Set the slope to 0: you get a constant function, a horizontal line.

narration.en: Start with y = x, the identity function, then change the slope and intercept. Set the slope to 0: you get a constant function, a horizontal line.
Move the point x₀ and read |x₀|, [x₀] and sgn x₀ off the three graphs.

caption.en: Move the point x₀ and read |x₀|, [x₀] and sgn x₀ off the three graphs.

tryThis.en: Set x₀ = −2.5. Is [−2.5] equal to −2 or −3?
Move x₀ from 0.9 to 1.0. Which graph jumps?

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find [3.2], [−3.2], |−3.2| and signum(−3.2).

heading.en: Greatest integer of a negative number

body.en: For a negative non-integer, drop the decimal part and subtract one more: [−2.1] = −3, not −2. The greatest integer always moves left on the number line.

narration.en: Greatest integer of a negative number. For a negative non-integer, drop the decimal part and subtract one more: [−2.1] = −3, not −2. The greatest integer always moves left on the number line.

mnemonic.en: Floor goes DOWN, even for negatives

narration.en: Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two competitive-exam pattern questions. Try them before we reveal the answers.

points.en: Identity y = x and constant y = c are straight lines.
points.kn: ಸರ್ವಸಮ y = x ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿರ y = c ಸರಳ ರೇಖೆಗಳು.

points.en: [x] is the greatest integer ≤ x; its range is Z.
points.kn: [x] ಎಂದರೆ x ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಲ್ಲದ ಮಹತ್ತಮ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ; ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ Z.

homework.en: Draw the graph of f(x) = |x − 1| for −2 ≤ x ≤ 4.

narration.en: Recap. Identity y = x and constant y = c are straight lines. |x| has range [0, ∞); signum has range {−1, 0, 1}. [x] is the greatest integer ≤ x; its range is Z.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸರ್ವಸಮ y = x ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿರ y = c ಸರಳ ರೇಖೆಗಳು. |x| ನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ [0, ∞); ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಫಲನದ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ {−1, 0, 1}. [x] ಎಂದರೆ x ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಲ್ಲದ ಮಹತ್ತಮ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ; ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ Z.
